unpolarized_karyotype_calls.description: One row per (sample, candidate). Karyotype is on the 0/1/2 axis without polarity (the polarizer decides which direction is reference vs derived).

karyotype.description: Allele dosage class; NA when no call could be made above confidence_floor.

dosage.description: Underlying continuous dosage that produced the call (∈ [0, 2]).

chain_score.description: Aggregated chain_evidence support inside the candidate span (0–1).

band_fraction.description: Fraction of windows in the candidate span whose window_band agrees with the called class (0–1).

caller_summary.description: Per-candidate roll-up (counts per class, n_NA, mean chain_score). Always emitted; small.
